header.name: Solar System V07
header.description: Solar System, increment 7 of 7: the timeline starts on 1958-01-31, when Explorer 1, the first US satellite, launched. Halley's Comet, Encke and Tempel 1 added on their true orbits. One lap of Pluto plays once. Tap a planet to open its own view.
